evals.prompt: Redesign the EXT:news detail page in our site package and add a related-news sidebar without breaking SEO or FAL image processing.
evals.expected_output: A site-package template/partial change that preserves required News detail ViewHelpers and uses native related-content and image APIs.
expectations: Checks the installed News version and the vendor template before choosing ViewHelpers or variables.
Preserves the installed detail page's title/meta and exclusion behavior.
Uses FAL image ViewHelpers and verifies the actual detail URL after asset/cache steps.

evals.prompt: Restyle the News search form and add a browser test, but I have not provided the search result page URL.
evals.expected_output: A search template plan that requests or discovers the configured target page rather than hardcoding a guessed URL.
expectations: Keeps the native News request parameter and routing contract intact.
Does not guess a plugin page URL for browser tests.
Uses project-specific CSS/build commands instead of assuming DDEV or Tailwind.

evals.prompt: Design a new Event Extbase domain model and repository unrelated to georgringer/news.
evals.expected_output: The response identifies the request as a custom domain feature outside the News Extension skill.
expectations: Does not suggest repurposing the News extension for an unrelated domain model.
States the boundary and leaves custom Extbase architecture to an appropriate workflow.
